title: Slice file
description: Slices for one workspace, authored as human-editable JSON in slices/*.json and validated by skills/slice/scripts/slice_tools.py. A slice is an ordered one-dimensional selection of cells that ALREADY EXIST in the IR — it never creates, edits, or deletes a cell. Cells are referenced by their qualified key (<service>/<phase>/<scenario>/<path>/<lane>/<step>); database UUIDs are UUIDv5-derived from that key plus the locale, exactly as in the IR import, so a slice and the blueprint it slices always agree on cell identity. Both are written to slides: cell_ids for the join the app runs, cell_keys so a re-import (which is delete-and-reinsert) leaves a recoverable trail. Text fields are locale maps; structural fields are locale-independent.

schema_version.description: Slice-file schema version. Bump the major on any breaking key-path change.

localeText.description: Locale map, e.g. {"en": "...", "zh": "..."}. Resolution falls back through the IR's declared locale order.

key.description: Stable, locale-independent slice key. The slice's UUID derives from it — renaming after import creates a NEW slice and orphans the old one.

type.description: journey = one actor's experience (own-lane cells plus what they demonstrably touch); step = one column across lanes; lane = one lane across steps; cell = a single cell read closely; custom = an explicitly listed set. A storyboard is a RENDERING of a journey slice, not a sixth type.

scenario.description: <phase>/<scenario> key. v1 slices are single-scenario: the app resolves a slice's canvas from its cells, and cells from two scenarios share no canvas.

path.description: The path key the selection was taken from. One path choice per slice — a slice that mixed paths would claim a journey nobody can walk.

actor.description: Whose slice this is, as a display label. Required in spirit for journey and lane; meaningless for step.

origin.description: generated = agent-authored, safe to regenerate in place. customized = agent-authored then hand-edited; regeneration needs explicit confirmation. human = authored in the app; agents never overwrite it.

order.description: Sort order within the slice's type group in the sidebar.

frames.description: Ordered frames. A frame groups the cells that are read together — one moment of the slice. Frame order IS the slice's order; there is no separate index.

items.description: Qualified cell key: <service>/<phase>/<scenario>/<path>/<lane>/<step>. Must resolve in the IR — an unresolvable key is a hard validation failure, never a warning.

cells.description: Cells in this frame, in reading order. A cell may appear in at most one frame of a slice.

narrative.description: Prose for this frame. MUST NOT quote evidence excerpts or proposition figures verbatim — slices are public-read artifacts; cite by cell key instead.

illustration.description: Optional image for this slide. Written by the storyboard sub-flow, not by hand.

prompt.description: Redacted prompt — persona archetype only, never a real person, org, or contact string.

updated_at.description: Stamped on regeneration; the app cache-busts on it.
